name: spindev-core
description: Core spinlockdevelopment skills for Claude Code project and session lifecycle — end-session wrap-up, init-project baseline, review-plan pre-implementation hardening, the gh GitHub-ops playbook, and the pr-prepass subagent (mirrors a repo's PR auto-review CI locally before push). Ships /end-session, /init-project, /pr-prepass, and /review-plan slash commands plus a non-blocking gh-workflow PreToolUse hook.
